config.createtailwind.title: Create: Tailwind
Whether jetpacks leave a smoke trail behind them.
config.createtailwind.particles.lifetime: How long each puff of smoke lasts at most. Each one lives between three quarters of this and all of it, so the trail frays unevenly.
How many of the smoke puffs to show. Lower it to thin the trail out.
config.createtailwind.sound.enabled.desc: Whether jetpacks make an engine sound while flying.
config.createtailwind.sound.volume.descr: How loud the jetpack engine is. Applied on top of the Players volume slider.
config.createtailwind.jetpack.air_consum: Average air drawn from the jetpack for every tick of flight. Fractions are drawn as a chance each tick.
config.createtailwind.jetpack.immune_to_: Whether a worn jetpack protects from fall damage, the way creative flight does.
config.createtailwind.jetpack.remove_inv: Whether flying with a jetpack removes Invisibility, since the exhaust gives the player away.
config.createtailwind.server.unavailable: Server settings belong to the world. Change them here from a singleplayer world that is not open to LAN, or on a server in serverconfig/createtailwind-server.toml inside the world folder.
config.createtailwind.yacl.missing: Yet Another Config Lib is not installed
config.createtailwind.yacl.missing.messa: YACL 3 is required to edit the config in game, would you like to install YACL 3?
config.createtailwind.yacl.outdated: Yet Another Config Lib is outdated
config.createtailwind.yacl.outdated.mess: The latest version of YACL 3 is required to edit the config in game, would you like to update YACL 3?
